Title: Data Technology DMX SSA Data Engineer
Description: Your Team Responsibilities We’re a global, cross-functional team of data engineers and DevOps engineers led by a hands-on team lead. We build and operate the data platform and services that power analytics and mission-critical business use cases. We value pragmatic architecture, reliable delivery, and frequent PoCs to validate ideas quickly, leveraging modern tools—including AI—to accelerate development and innovation. We’re looking for a senior team member who can lead initiatives end-to-end—from clarifying requirements with stakeholders, to architecting solution components, implementing PoCs, and guiding production rollout. This role suits a broad generalist in the data domain with strong software engineering fundamentals and an architectural mindset. Your Key Responsibilities Build the future MSCI Analytics Data platform Collaborate with Product Management, Program Management and other internal stakeholders to convert business requirements into applications, tools, and deliver these as part of a product release roadmap. Collaborate with engineering teams across data and technology in implementing AI solutions and integrating services with MSCI’s data science products and platforms. Improve and create a modern and sophisticated platform using latest technologies and following industry best practices. Evaluate different Architectural & Design approaches, solutions, frameworks & technologies and recommend the most suitable one. Develop best practices for architecture, design, coding & automated test coverage. Architect, Design and develop secure, high performance, scalable and maintainable applications using appropriate architectural patterns. Ensure optimal availability, latency, scalability, and efficiency of real-time application development by advocating engineering reliability into the development life cycle with a focus on fault tolerant approaches. Our global operations team handles production support. This role is development-focused with no on-call responsibilities outside business hours. Contribute actively to the organization’s AI adoption by identifying use cases, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and leveraging AI-enabled tools to drive innovation, scalability, and competitive advantage. Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel Broad data technology knowledge (breadth over depth): Relational databases (e.g., Postgres/MySQL/SQL Server/Oracle) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB/Cassandra/DynamoDB). Data warehousing/lake patterns (e.g., Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, cloud data lake/lakehouse). Data formats & interchange (Parquet, JSON, Avro). 3+ years plus experience with one or more of the following languages: Python, Bash, Go (Go would be preferred) DevOps fluency: version control (Git), CI/CD, containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes or equivalent), and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform). Highly organized and transparent: able to structure work clearly, maintain accurate documentation of designs, decisions, and processes, ensuring visibility for the team and stakeholders. Mentor and support junior colleagues: share your experience, provide guidance on best practices, and help grow the team’s technical capabilities. Knowledge of C++/Java/Scala is a plus. Working experience with automated scheduling such as AutoSys or Control-M is plus About MSCI What we offer you Salary range: $95,000 - $124,000 / year plus eligible for annual bonus Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development. Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles. We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum. At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry. MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. Title: Calculation Engine Engineer
Description: Build a career with confidence Carrier Global Corporation, a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we’ve led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. About The Role Carrier is seeking a passionate and experienced Calculation Engine Engineer to join our Modeling and Simulation team. This role is critical to the development and deployment of best‑in‑class calculation platforms that support Carrier’s commercial HVAC equipment portfolio. Job Description In this position, you will apply advanced thermodynamics, heat transfer, and numerical methods to develop robust, scalable calculation engines that enable optimized product selection and superior customer solutions. You will collaborate closely with marketing, product engineering, and global stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into high‑performance engineering models. Key Responsibilities In this role, you will: Design, develop, and maintain state‑of‑the‑art calculation engines that support Carrier’s commercial HVAC product offerings and sales tools. Apply expertise in heat transfer, thermodynamics, and numerical methods to develop accurate and reliable engineering algorithms. Collaborate with optimization engineers to develop advanced algorithms that enable optimal system selection and performance predictions. Work cross‑functionally with marketing, product engineering, and global teams to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Support the integration and deployment of calculation engines into Carrier’s modeling and configuration platforms. Ensure model accuracy, robustness, scalability, and maintainability through validation, testing, and continuous improvement. Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing across teams. Minimum Requirements Strong foundational knowledge of: Heat transfer Thermodynamics Numerical analysis Nonlinear algebraic and differential equation systems Hands‑on programming experience in one or more of the following: Python, Modelica (TOP), C++ or related programming languages. Engineering experience in design, analysis, or application of HVAC/R or power plant equipment. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Proven ability to collaborate effectively across functions and global teams. Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing and maintaining software across multiple programming languages. Experience leading or mentoring technical teams or delivering engineering tools/models to meet stakeholder requirements. Familiarity with optimization techniques, simulation platforms, or product configuration systems. This is The Carrier Way . Join us and make a difference. Apply Now! Title: Senior Developer Product Master Data
Description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description As the Senior Developer, Product Master Data, you work as part of a team of developers who maintain data management tools/apps that support product data management processes within Rockwell Automation. Your Responsibilities Maintain data management tools/apps used to support creation and maintenance of product master data including material master and supporting data objects. You will report to: TECHNICAL TEAM LEAD, PRODUCT DATA MANAGEMENT Work under management on complex issues where analysis may require discovery of global business processes, and organizational goals in areas not directly related to this position. Work with peers and customers (typically internal) to exchange or present information. Compile and assess user feedback to improve application performance Build working relationships throughout the global organization. Ability to find and fix errors in programs and software. Maintain proper coding practices and documentation. Apply company procedures to resolve routine issues in master data management. The Essentials - You Will Have Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology/Computer Science, or a related field. 5 years minimum of related experience in similar position The Preferred - You Might Also Have Experience applying Artificial Intelligence techniques in application development and software engineering. Database design and SQL query development skills. Experience with Cloud computing architecture. Have and the ability to determine the causes of master data issues. Have a logical, analytical, and creative approach to application development. Willingness to participate in project teams. Is comfortable working with colleagues in multiple tasks. Self-drive and experience with learning. Ability to learn/develop an expertise in master data management Any SAP experience is desirable. Any experience with low-code/no-code app platform development is desirable. Microsoft Power Platform experience is desirable. Microsoft Power Business intelligence and data visualization (Power BI) is desirable. Microsoft Azure Cloud experience is desirable. Cloud API development experience is desirable. HTML, JavaScript, or CSS is desirable. Microsoft VBA experience within MS Access and MS Excel is desirable. SAP ECC or similar ERP systems Experience with data structures and relationships Workflow design and implementation (ex: PowerApps, Agile Point NX) Data automation tools (ex: Precisely Automate Studio/Winshuttle) Data analysis and the ability to correlate data with business process requirements Experience with JavaScript, jQuery, Python, CSS, PowerShell, and User Interface design. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Maven, GitLab Experience deploying code in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments. Benefits Saving Fund Food coupons. Major medical insurance Retirement benefit We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
